selection_rationale: All-3g fleet that can dictate range: 40 torpedoes in a coordinated saturation salvo, with frigates as PD screens and cheap decoys. Kite and fire from range, avoiding slow capitals.
formation_rationale: Cheap frigates forward as vanguard to absorb the first exchange. Corvettes sit behind them within ~60 km lateral spread, so their PD overlaps. Small vertical offsets complicate the enemy's firing geometry without breaking PD coverage.
